# 10. 기능 카탈로그 (Feature Catalog)

quanta-codeagent-v3에 **구현·배선된** 기능 전수 목록. **대**(주요 시스템) → **중**(하위 능력) → **소**(구체 기능/노브) 3단.

근거: RFC `rfc/0001-architecture.md`, ADR `docs/decisions/0001~0027`. cross-import는 `@/agent`만(슬라이스 격리). 운영 reference: [docs/runbooks/agent-loop-reference.md](docs/runbooks/agent-loop-reference.md).

## 성숙도 5단계 척도

있다/없다 이분이 아니라 **구현 폐쇄도(closure)** 를 5단계로:

| 등급 | 의미 |
|---|---|
| **L5 ●●●●●** | 완성·검증 — 구현·배선·단위+통합테스트, **실 LLM 스모크 또는 e2e 폐쇄** 확인됨 |
| **L4 ●●●●○** | 견고 — 구현·배선·단위+통합테스트(실 runAgent, mock LLM). 실 LLM 스모크는 미실시 |
| **L3 ●●●○○** | 동작 — 구현·배선됨, **단위테스트 위주**(통합 미검증) |
| **L2 ●●○○○** | 부분/한계 — 동작하나 **의도적 제약·advisory·옵셔널 미도달** |
| **L1 ●○○○○** | 골격/보류 — **타입/API만 노출**, 루프 미배선, 의식적 후속 |

`⚙️` = env/config 노브(기본 OFF·behavior-preserving).

> **R-Phase1-4 closure (2026-05-21)** — 2-round 코드 audit(8 parallel agents) 후 correctness + observability + 정직성 일괄 폐쇄. **P0** (HIGH): streaming-dispatch 3개소 rejection 경로(`Promise.all` → `Promise.allSettled`, drainDeferredSlots try/catch, collectResultBlocks 합성 `dispatchFailedBlock`) — ordering invariant 회복; `maybeCompact()` try-catch + `error` 이벤트 + graceful degrade; `resolveMemoryContext()` 동등 처리. **P1** (MED): proactive compaction 성공 시 `recovery:{reason:"compact",detail:"proactive"}` 방출(reactive 대칭); `stream_reset` tombstone orphan promise `.catch(()=>{})` 가드(Bun unhandledRejection 방지); jsonl-recorder degraded-line 실패에 `logger.warn` 진단; streamingTurn `AbortSignal` 계약 docstring. **P3** (defensive): CLI 진입점 `process.on("unhandledRejection")` defense-in-depth; `HookBus.on` 제너릭 cast → closure-erasure(런타임 안전 + 타입 표면 개선); `WorkingMemory.snapshot` shallow-copy 명시(`WorkingState.snapshot`의 deep-copy와 구분). **P2** 회귀 테스트 6개 파일(40 신규 테스트): `streaming-dispatch-rejection-e2e`(4), `observability-error-event-e2e`(4 — P0-2/P0-3/P1-1 검증 + default-OFF 회귀 가드), `skill-discover-errors`(11), `lsp-bridge-probe`(3 — Promise.race 5s 타임아웃 + 캐시 + extension fast-path), `mcp-client-errors`(8 — empty command + not-running), `env-knob-branches`(35 — `pickProvider`/`buildStore`/`buildMemoryConfig`/`parseRecallTiers`/`buildSubagentConfig`/`buildVerifyGuardConfig`/`buildSkillsConfig` 전 분기). 모든 변경 default-OFF byte-identical 불변식 무손상.
>
> **R-Phase5 closure (2026-05-21)** — 또 2-round 코드 audit(8 parallel agents) 추가 진행 후 7건 fix + 7 regression test. **P0** (HIGH): (A) `features.cleanup` hook이 `loop.ts finish()` 어디에도 invoke되지 않아 background subagent 자식이 부모 abort 시 orphan — 5 finish 사이트 모두 cleanup invoke + try-catch(`error` 이벤트로 surface, default-OFF 시 optional chain 무동작). (B) `cacheConversationPrefix`가 마지막 블록이 `tool_use`/`tool_result`/`thinking`일 때 `cache_control`을 비-text 블록에 부착 (Anthropic API 무시 + 일부 버전에서 reject) — backward walk으로 last text 블록을 찾아 부착, text 블록 부재 시 graceful no-op. (C) `onConfirm` 콜백이 throw할 때 admissibility-gate가 propagate(2개소: HITL always-confirm 114, mode-policy ask 149) — try-catch로 wrap, `preview:"error"` 태그된 deny로 surface. **P1** (MED): (D) `HARD_DENY rm-recursive-force-system-root` 정규식 3개 `[\s\S]*?` lookahead unbounded ReDoS 위험 → `{0,500}?` 명시 bound(real bash command well under, adversarial 10KB+ input 100ms 미만 완료). (F) anthropic adapter `thinking_delta` explicit drain(Phase-1 intent 문서화). (G) FallbackLLM이 fallback provider가 zero event yield + prior partial 존재 시 stream_reset tombstone 누락 → for-await 외부에서 명시 emit. (H) `SqliteStore.save()` INSERT 동기 throw가 `Promise<void>` boundary를 우회 → try-catch + `Promise.reject(new Error("SqliteStore.save(<id>) failed: ..."))`. **회귀 테스트 7 파일(43 tests)**: `subagent-cleanup-invocation-e2e`(3), `anthropic-cache-control-blocks`(5), `onconfirm-throw`(5 — 3개 throw path + 2개 control), `hard-deny-redos-bound`(11 — positive/negative + 10KB adversarial timing < 100ms), `anthropic-thinking-delta`(4), `fallback-empty-tombstone`(4), `sqlite-save-error`(5). 모든 변경 default-OFF byte-identical 불변식 무손상(`features.cleanup?.()` optional chain, fallback의 prior-partial gate, etc.).
>
> **R-Phase6 catalog-truth pass (2026-05-21)** — 4-agent 병렬 audit 후 카탈로그 정직성 갱신. 코드 무수정, 카탈로그 갱신만:

JSON-RPC/stdio 경계의 untrusted-server CVE surface 폐쇄.

>
> **R-Phase7 fault-localization 도구 (2026-05-21)** — Agentless 3-stage(file→function→edit-location) funnel + codex-검증 신호 도구 흡수. **3-stage 구조 (Hybrid A+C, RFC §1.2 정합 — 신규 도구 0 for funnel, micro-FSM 회피)**: (A) `prompt.ts` tool routing matrix에 "localize a fault → localize/grep → read+lsp_document_symbol → lsp_references" 한 줄 추가; (C) `src/skill/system-skills/localize-fault/SKILL.md` 신설 — Stage1 FILE / Stage2 FUNCTION / Stage3 EDIT-LOCATION + outcome enum(`located`/`narrowed`/`uncertain`) + 4-truth-surface + 신호 위계("rg locates, source proves" — source text 10/10 > rg hits 5/10). `triggerLocalizeFault`/`findLocalizeFaultSkill`/`LOCALIZE_FAULT_SKILL_NAME` wiring seam(progress-audit 미러). **신규 도구 4종 (codex signal absorption, all read-only + concurrency-safe + MUTATING_TOOL_TABLE `null`)**: (1) `file_tree_summary` — depth-bounded .gitignore-respecting 디렉터리 트리 + per-dir 파일 카운트 (Stage-1 structure; codex file-topology 7/6); (2) `parse_test_failure` — pure 파서, raw 테스트/빌드 로그 → `file:line [framework]` 추출 (pytest/python-traceback/jest/vitest/bun/go-test/cargo; Stage-3, build-log 8/9 trust); (3) `git_churn` — 변경 빈도 hotspot 랭킹 (Stage-1 recency); (4) `git_blame_heatmap` — per-author 라인 ownership 분포 (Stage-1 ownership). defaultTools에 `file_tree_summary`+`parse_test_failure` 등록(byte-identical: 미호출 세션 무변경), gitTools 6→8(`QUANTA_GIT_TOOLS` opt-in 유지). **회귀 테스트 5 파일(약 70 tests)**: `skill-localize-fault`(frontmatter+3-stage body+wiring), `file-tree-summary`(트리/depth/cap/jail), `parse-test-failure`(6 framework + dedup + reject), `git-churn-blame-heatmap`(pure rank + tool 양면), `prompt-system` routing 단언 추가. **통합 가드 수정**: `MUTATING_TOOL_TABLE`(mode.ts) 4 entry(전부 read-only `null`), git-tools barrel count 6→8 단언. 모든 변경 default-OFF byte-identical 불변식 무손상.
>
> **R-Phase7b system-skills 런타임 배선 (2026-05-21)** — localize-fault/progress-audit 스킬이 만들어졌지만 `config.skills`가 `{ dir: string }` 필수라 `QUANTA_SKILLS_DIR` 미설정 시 **루프에서 도달 불가**였던 갭 폐쇄(ADR-0045 "유저가 env var 기억 안 해도 discipline 스킬은 available" 약속 위반). 수정: (1) `AgentConfig.skills.dir`를 optional로 (`{ dir?: string; changedPaths?: string[] }`); (2) `buildSkillFeatures`가 dir 부재 시 user 스킬 discovery 스킵 + bundled system 스킬만 로드; (3) CLI `buildSkillsConfig` 3-state — `QUANTA_SKILLS_DIR=<path>`→`{dir}`(user+system), `QUANTA_SKILLS=1`/`--skills`→`{}`(system only), 둘 다 없으면 `undefined`(byte-identical OFF). 이제 `QUANTA_SKILLS=1`만으로 localize-fault+progress-audit 즉시 invocable. 스킬 ABSENT 세션은 여전히 Skill 도구 미등록(RFC §1.2 무손상). 회귀 테스트: `features.test.ts`에 `skills:{}`→bundled 양쪽 discovered + ABSENT→no Skill tool 단언, `env-knob-branches`에 3-state 분기.
>
> **R-Phase8 fault-localization 도구 품질 강화 (2026-05-21)** — R-Phase7 도구 4종 비판적 audit 후 진짜 품질 갭 4건 구조적 폐쇄. **#1 `parse_test_failure` vendored 필터 + user-code-first 랭킹** (최고 레버리지): `FrameTier`(user>test>vendored) + `classifyFrame`(node_modules/.pnp/site-packages/.venv/.cargo/vendor/dist/build/target) + TEST_FILE 휴리스틱. tier-우선 정렬(동률 시 discovery 순) + **랭킹 후 cap** → vendored flood가 user 프레임을 max_results 밖으로 못 밀어냄(codex build-log 8/9 trust). **#2 probe 3-stage funnel 측정 장치** (honesty loop): `apps/probe/funnel.ts` `observeFunnel`/`renderFunnel` + `probe --funnel` — trajectory tool_call 시퀀스에서 file→function→edit-location **monotonic** 진행 관찰, NON-authoritative(낮은 stage는 결함 아님). R-Phase7이 약속한 "probe trace 측정"을 실제 구현 → 옵션 B 승격 근거(RFC §9.1). **#3 `file_tree_summary` purpose layer**: `summarize:true` → `rg -m1` 두 번째 패스로 파일별 첫 선언/주석 추출 + ` — <hint>` 주석(200파일 cap, 80자 truncate, 실패 시 구조-only degrade). **#4 `git_blame_heatmap` line-range**: `start_line`/`end_line` → `git blame -L`로 함수 단위 ownership, zod refine으로 paired+ordered 강제. **회귀 73 tests/5 files green**. 의도적 보류: 옵션 B `localize_hierarchical`(micro-FSM, funnel 데이터 보고 결정), embedding search, AST fallback. read-only + concurrency-safe + byte-identical.
>
> **베이스라인 주의 (R-Phase7~8 시점)** — 본 단락 작성 시점 repo는 다수 외부 병렬 WIP(Wave A ReviewerPort, ADR-0030 mid-turn steering, Wave D vocabulary, apps/cli/slash-commands `process.env`)로 인해 full `bun test`에 ~58개 외부 failure가 존재(R-Phase7~8 추가와 무관 — 본 도구/스킬/배선/강화 테스트는 전부 green, MINE-related failure 0 확인 + 외부 `apply_patch` MUTATING_TOOL_TABLE 누락도 함께 수정해 공유 drift gate 회복). 따라서 `refresh-baseline.ts` 실행을 의도적으로 보류(외부 WIP failure를 baseline으로 기록하지 않기 위함). 베이스라인 수치는 외부 WIP 안정화 후 갱신 예정 — 위 R-Phase6 수치(205 files)는 R-Phase7(도구 4 + 스킬 1 + 배선) + R-Phase8(품질 강화 4 + probe funnel) 추가분을 미반영.

Gap-1 — Provider refusal/abnormal stop: decideOnAssembled에 stopReason==="refusal" 신규 브랜치(max_tokens / tool_use / empty 앞) → terminal {do:"error", reason:"Model refused to continue …"}, outputContinues / malformedRetries / consecutiveEmpties 미소비. pre-ADR fall-through는 refusal 텍스트를 정상 completion으로 위장(가장 ROI 높은 fix). pause_turn / content_filtered / guardrail_intervened는 dead code 회피 — 서버 도구 / Bedrock guardrail 흡수 시 재평가. Gap-2 — Reasoning/thinking carry-over: StreamEvent에 thinking_delta + signature_delta 추가, assembleFromEvents가 연속 delta를 1 ThinkingBlock으로 fold + signature를 last ThinkingBlock에 부착, 어시스턴트 메시지 prepend로 provider order(thinking before text/tool_use) 보존. Anthropic SSE / OpenAI reasoning summary 어댑터 emit. multi-turn carry-over는 자동 — ThinkingBlock이 메시지에 타고, wm.append → 다음 턴 StreamInput.messages → 어댑터가 wire 형식으로 재직렬화. Gap-4 — deny_and_steer verb: ConfirmDecision discriminated union {allow\|deny\|deny_and_steer{steer}} + AgentConfig.onConfirm 시그니처 확장 + normalizeConfirm bridge(boolean ↔ ConfirmDecision, 레거시 caller byte-identical). admissibility-gate의 always-confirm 브랜치가 deny_and_steer 시 deny DispatchResult를 emit하면서 steer를 result envelope steerInjection?: string에 attach. Gap-3 — Submission op dispatcher: 6-variant union shape는 존재하나 entry-point 분기는 deferred (loop.ts 동시 co-development 회피). Gap-5 — Refusal in-stream tool short-circuit (self-audit follow-up, 2026-05-22): streamingTurn의 Phase 3 (drainDeferredSlots — barrier-blocked unsafe tool dispatch)가 `stopReason === "refusal"`이면 SKIP. 자체 audit 발견 — 기존 Gap-1은 `decideOnAssembled`(post-stream)에서만 단락하므로 mid-stream tool_use 가 deferred slot으로 들어간 후 message_stop=refusal이 와도 bash가 실제로 실행되었음(smoke 15-refusal-mid-tool가 매 CI run마다 `echo malicious` 실행). Phase 4는 dispatched slot(promise!==undefined)만 collect — orphan tool_use 블록은 message.content에 남지만 runStep의 error 분기가 wm.append 없이 즉시 종료하므로 carry-over 오염 없음. byte-identical: non-refusal 경로 변화 0. Hell-gate hardening (181 hell case + 2 e2e smoke): 6 신규 hell-test file이 3개 추가 invariant를 PIN — (i) signature_delta가 thinking_delta 없이 도착하면 ThinkingBlock 합성하지 않고 silently drop (orphan은 후속 thinking에 back-attach 안 함), (ii) ConfirmDecision normalize는 `{__proto__:{decision:"allow"}}`형 prototype-pollution 입력에 대해 보호적으로 deny로 narrow, (iii) OpenAI content_filter finish_reason은 last-wins. 부분 와이어링(steerInjection emit OK / loop consumer 미연결)은 G-1~G-1d 4-test partial-wiring guard로 파일 grep 기반 regression pin — 향후 wiring PR이 guard를 의식적으로 갱신하지 않으면 자동 실패. · src/agent/loop.ts, src/agent/confirm-decision.ts · ADR-76 · 17u/5i<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:core · tier:core<br>**의존**: agent-types-split, fallback-kinds-policy, llm-factory, model-swap-retry, plan-mode<br>**UI**: cli<br>**Monitoring**: integrated · keys: gen_ai.response.time_to_first_token_ms, quanta.conversation.id, quanta.hitl |

(B1 tool_namespace) a closed ToolNamespaceStrategy injected into SubagentRunnerOptions: when set, a spawned child's filtered ToolRegistry is rewritten so each tool name is scoped (default prefixToolNamespace keyed by the child's deterministic mailbox label root/0,root/1…), giving concurrent siblings disjoint tool surfaces; dispatch resolves the scoped name straight back to the real tool. Absent ⇒ raw names exactly as today. Closes the previously unbounded per-call timeout hole. (B3 concurrency cap) an optional maxConcurrent dep on handleSpawnAgent counting running tasks via the registry's pendingIds(); over-cap spawns return a structured {kind:"error", cause:"concurrency_cap"} mirroring the pty_cap pattern. Default = unlimited (opt-in) so every existing spawn path is byte-identical. 2026-06-02 PROMOTION + GAP-CLOSE: the three seams are top-level config.subagent knobs (SubagentBlock.{toolNamespace, waitTimeoutPolicy, maxConcurrent}) threaded by buildSubagentBlock, AND the 6-tool router now has a LIVE assembly site (createSubagent6Tools, gated by config.subagent.enable6Tools). | Mention-driven explicit context injection (folder + git resolver impls) | @folder + @git mention resolvers (§10.3 Cursor parity) | **L3** `[A]` | §10.3 — the `@folder` and `@git` mention-resolver IMPLs (Cursor `@Folders` / `@git` parity). Two `MentionResolverPort` method factories that the composite resolver attaches when their dep is supplied; the seven-kind parser (ADR-0418) emits `folder` (a path ENDING in `/`) and `git` (the reserved `@git` literal / `@git:(status\|diff\|log)`) tokens that dispatch here. `createFolderResolver` (folder-resolver.ts) — async directory listing. Captures a workspace `root`, resolves a `@dir/` target relative to it, and renders a BOUNDED, DETERMINISTIC listing as the mention bodyText: dirents byte-sorted, dirs suffixed `/`, capped at `maxEntries` (default 200) with a trailing `… (+N more)` marker over-cap. fs-jail: `fs.realpath` canonicalises both sides and `is-path-inside` rejects any target outside the captured root (symlink escapes followed + rejected). NO-THROW — missing dir / non-dir target / EACCES / outside-jail / empty-or-non-string target / absent root all degrade to `null` (skip), never a throw. `createGitResolver` (git-resolver.ts) — git-context body. The slice NEVER spawns git itself; the caller INJECTS a `GitContextProvider` (an async port the runner backs with `@/runtime`'s `runShell`; tests inject a canned provider for deterministic replay). The subcommand is a CLOSED enum (`status\|diff\|log`) the parser guarantees — the resolver re-validates against a `VALID_SUBS` Set and rejects any unknown subcommand with no fallback (a hostile direct caller can't smuggle an arbitrary arg). The provider's text is trimmed (blank ⇒ `null`, i.e. clean tree / non-repo) and truncated to `maxBytes` (default 32 KiB) on a LINE boundary; truncation is BYTE-based (Buffer slice + decode replaces a split multibyte sequence with U+FFFD) so the cap can't be over-run and a surrogate pair can't be split. NO-THROW — a throwing / rejecting provider logs a warn and yields `null`. Both resolvers are second-line-guarded by ADR-0325's `safeCall` wrapper (belt-and-suspenders) and gated default-ON per kind: `QUANTA_MENTION_FOLDER` / `QUANTA_MENTION_GIT` (=off opts that kind out). The composite attaches a method ONLY when its dep is supplied, so omitting both keeps the pre-§10.3 port shape byte-identical (no `resolveFolder` / `resolveGit` key) — proven by the byte-identity D1/D2 cases. · src/agent/plugin-app-resolver/folder-resolver.ts, src/agent/plugin-app-resolver/git-resolver.ts · ADR-docs/decisions/0418-async-mention-resolver-and-file-symbol.md,docs/decisions/0336-plugin-app-resolver.md,docs/decisions/0325-mention-based-explicit-injection.md · 1u · ⚙️QUANTA_MENTION_FOLDER, QUANTA_MENTION_FOLDER_MAX_ENTRIES, QUANTA_MENTION_GIT, QUANTA_MENTION_GIT_MAX_BYTES, QUANTA_PLUGIN_POINTERS<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:core · absorbed:cursor · default-on<br>**의존**: async-mention-resolver-and-file-symbol<br>**UI**: cli<br>**Modes**: interactive<br>**Configurable**: integrated · env: QUANTA_MENTION_FOLDER, QUANTA_MENTION_FOLDER_MAX_ENTRIES, QUANTA_MENTION_GIT |

| Per-turn dynamic system-reminder — behavioral prompt directives | §5 prompt-level directive bundle — seven DEFAULT-OFF behavioral directives | **L4** `[B]` | Seven cheap, high-value behavioral PROMPT DIRECTIVES, each an independent DEFAULT-OFF gated section. Each mirrors the C3 brief-mode mechanism: the directive text is spliced into the per-turn DYNAMIC `<system-reminder>` slot by `buildDynamicContext` (`src/agent/prompt.ts`) ONLY when its knob is ON — never into the static cached prefix. So flipping any knob never invalidates the provider cache prefix, and ALL knobs unset ⇒ the bundle contributes ZERO bytes ⇒ the per-turn reminder is byte-for-bit identical to the pre-bundle output. The seven directives: 1. AUTONOMOUS (QUANTA_DIRECTIVE_AUTONOMOUS) — unattended/headless posture: bias to safe forward progress, do not block on questions, checkpoint, do not fabricate completion. 2. READ_COMPLETE (QUANTA_DIRECTIVE_READ_COMPLETE) — read the relevant span of a large file COMPLETELY before concluding; truncate-and-guess is a defect. 3. PROGRESS (QUANTA_DIRECTIVE_PROGRESS) — concise, information-dense status; narration only; never suppresses error/verification/evidence reporting. 4. MEMORY_VERIFY (QUANTA_DIRECTIVE_MEMORY_VERIFY) — a recalled memory is a hint; verify a named file/symbol/flag still exists in the CURRENT code before acting on or citing it. 5. THINK_FREQ (QUANTA_DIRECTIVE_THINK_FREQ) — match reasoning depth to task complexity; deliberate on hard steps, move fast on mechanical ones. 6. ANTI_PLATITUDE (QUANTA_DIRECTIVE_ANTI_PLATITUDE) — substance only; no empty affirmations / filler praise; disagree plainly when evidence warrants. 7. PARALLEL_TOOLS (QUANTA_DIRECTIVE_PARALLEL_TOOLS) — batch INDEPENDENT tool calls in a single turn; sequential only on a real data dependency. 8. ADVISOR_RAIL (QUANTA_ADVISOR_RAIL, RFC jun-6 §5.2) — when the `advisor` tool is available, consult it BEFORE committing to an approach and BEFORE declaring done; mentions forwardHistory:true (cc-cli advisor timing rail). BYTE-IDENTITY (headline invariant): the pure selector `selectActiveDirectives` returns "" when no knob is on, so nothing is pushed onto the dynamic parts and the assembled reminder equals the frozen golden. Determinism: active directives concatenate in a fixed source-declared order (`DIRECTIVE_ORDER`) — no Math.random, no Set-iteration ambiguity. Outcome woke (idle→immediate)/queued (mid-turn→next turn)/no-receiver; interrupt:true passes reason "interrupt". Non-root only (root never in registry ⇒ id_unknown), self-target rejected, and HONEST DEGRADATION: no live waker ⇒ cause:no_waker but the mailbox delivery still stands. Wired honesty: list_agents fully reflects real registry+meta (incl. a spawn-through-6-tool integration test); followup delivery is wired, AND (ADR-0437 follow-up, RFC §11) the runner now registers a real per-child waker into runAgent: spawn_agent threads its registry taskId onto SubagentRequest, the runner mints a per-child SubagentTurnGate + registers a Waker (bridged to that gate) under the SAME id followup_task targets, and the child loop PARKS on the gate at its clean- completion point. IDLE child interrupt = plain wake (nothing in flight). followup NEVER aborts. Guarantee: turn-level + cooperative-tool-level (an already-running tool sees ToolContext.signal; we do not force-kill a tool ignoring its signal — same cooperative contract as task_stop). | 에이전트 코어 — subagent spawn 모델 배선 (Cursor SubagentModelOverride 흡수) | Per-subagent model / role / effort override | **L4** `[B]` | A parent can assign a specific model and/or dispatch role and/or effort tier to a child it spawns via the `agent` tool (Cursor SubagentModelOverride: a planner on a deep-reasoning model delegating edits to a fast minimal-diff model). Threaded end-to-end: (1) SubagentRequest gains optional model?/role?/effort? (plain strings — the @/subagent slice owns no Role/EffortLevel enum, mirroring the TaskKind precedent); (2) the `agent` tool input schema exposes model (string) / role (string) / effort (enum default\|low\|medium\|high\|max), buildRequest omitting each when absent; (3) buildChildConfig resolves the child's effective LLM port — explicit req.model wins, else req.role via parent.roleModelResolver (ADR-0256), else parent.llm — and swaps the port via the EXISTING modelCandidates id→port lookup (the same mechanism loop.ts skill-model-swap uses, resolveSkillTurnOverride ~L491). effort is wired as the child's sessionEffort() thunk (the same seam the loop reads to cap the thinking budget via effortToTokenBudget). A tie → still fails. A measurement (verbatim-line count), not a tunable threshold. Safety: only converts a current FAIL into a recovery or the same fail — can never apply an edit to a window the current code wouldn't, and prefers false-negative over wrong-location. When present it PREFILTERS the candidate match windows to only those whose match lands inside ANY supplied range, applied BEFORE the existing exact→whitespace→anchored→scored ladder runs (a deterministic structural narrowing of the candidate set — it does NOT alter the exact/fuzzy scoring). A repeated anchor that today fails `ambiguous` outright (`exact.ts` returns `kind: "ambiguous"` on count > 1) becomes deterministically addressable — "the occurrence on lines 40-60" — with no extra LLM round-trip. Three modes by input: LIST (no threadId/all → unresolved-threads query, returns id + path + filters resolved), RESOLVE-ONE (threadId → mutation), RESOLVE-ALL (all:true → list then resolve each, re-listed after a potential rebase). Concurrent-push race: when {rebaseOnDivergence:true} and the local branch has diverged from origin/<headRef> (a teammate/CI bot pushed first), a BOUNDED (≤1) fetch+rebase runs BEFORE resolving — on conflict it `rebase --abort`s and FAILS CLOSED (no resolve), and a SECOND divergence after the single rebase ALSO fails closed (no unbounded fetch/rebase loop — the prior-audit unbounded-retry trap). With {rebaseOnDivergence:false} (default) divergence → ok:false {head_moved} and NO git mutation runs (the agent rebases explicitly). SECURITY: normalizeRef guards the PR ref; threadId is validated as an opaque node id ([A-Za-z0-9_=-], no leading '-') BEFORE argv; EVERY GraphQL value rides a NAMED -F/-f variable (owner/repo/pr/threadId) — never interpolated into the query body (the query/mutation are module constants), so a malicious threadId cannot break out of the variable. isReadOnly:false (the whole tool is mutating even though LIST is read-shaped — no "read tool that sometimes writes" hole); the mode's gitWrite lever is the structural gate. Closed-port DI: injected GhRunner (scrubEnv fence) + GitRunner (fetch/rebase boundary) — both fakeable, no network/repo in tests. · src/tool/gh/pr-resolve-thread.ts, src/tool/gh/index.ts · ADR-482,483 · 1u<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:cli · security-touched<br>**의존**: gh-arg-injection-guard, gh-pr-open-author-and-ship<br>**UI**: cli<br>**Configurable**: integrated |

This makes `read` notebook-aware: when the resolved path is `.ipynb` it routes the already-read text through a PURE `renderNotebook` (no new port) that parses `cells[]` and emits each cell's source line-numbered (`<n>\t<line>`, same convention as a raw read), tagged with a stable cell index + type (`[cell 3 · code]`). Each in-cell `await tools.X(args)` round-trips to the REAL `dispatchTool`, so permission / HARD_DENY / plan-mode gate EVERY call; loops/conditionals/fan-out happen in ONE cell = ONE model turn (the token + latency win on multi-step sequences). THE SECURITY MODEL (make-or-break, proven): there is exactly ONE dispatch path. `src/codemode/` is a DUMB sandbox that reaches the host ONLY via an injected `CodeCellDispatchPort`. The ONLY implementation of that port (`src/agent/codemode-wire.ts#buildCodeCellDispatchPort`) closes over the loop's LIVE `config`/`permission` (and optionally `autoClassifier`) and routes EACH in-cell call through the SAME `dispatchTool` the loop uses with a synthesized `cell_<cellId>_<seq>` ToolUseBlock. A code cell IS, to the permission system, N ordinary gated tool calls. (The composition-root wire leaves `autoClassifier` absent ⇒ in-cell read-only ops do NOT auto-pass — STRICTLY more restrictive than the direct path, never a bypass.) `@/codemode` CANNOT reach `dispatchTool` (biome fence) — inversion-of- control is the boundary. A cell can call ANY tool the agent has — EACH still routes through the SAME injected port → the real `dispatchTool` (the security invariant is UNCHANGED; only which NAMES are bound widened). A tool the agent lacks is absent from the surface ⇒ unbound (the cell can never widen itself). Snake_case names (`gh_pr_view`) are dot-reachable (`tools.gh_pr_view`, RFC §4.2). A MUTATING in-cell call (`tools.bash`/`tools.write`) hits the SAME admissibility gate / HARD_DENY / plan-mode as a direct call; a malformed arg is a typed tool failure (the tool safeParses inside dispatchTool), not a host crash; the per-cell call cap + output cap apply ACROSS the full surface. ABSENT surfaceTools ⇒ the sandbox falls back to the Phase-1 3-tool surface (`read`/`grep`/`write`) — byte-identical for a host that wired the port but not the surface. PHASE 3 — code_mode_only (jun-07, LIVE, default-OFF): `QUANTA_CODE_MODE_ONLY=1` splices a gated prompt directive (`CODE_MODE_ONLY_DIRECTIVE`, the §5 directive bundle) into the per-turn DYNAMIC `<system-reminder>` steering the model to drive multi-step work through `code_cell` programs as the PRIMARY tool-calling surface. PER THE RFC §5.3 decision: the directive STEERS via prompt; it does NOT hide individual tools from the menu (the tool catalog is byte-identical whether or not the steering is on — mutating tools stay directly reachable AND re-gated inside cells). Default-OFF ⇒ zero bytes (byte-identical dynamic tail). Independent of `codeMode` (the security gate); a host that wants the model to actually USE cells sets BOTH. Phase-2 cell-lifecycle stream events remain a follow-up (the per-cell ledger on the single tool result is the current observability surface). CAPS (RFC §4.4): WASM memory limit (setMemoryLimit), deadline interrupt (an infinite loop → typed timeout), per-cell tool-call cap (a runaway fan-out is refused at the binding BEFORE the host port), output cap (truncated), abort (the loop's AbortSignal interrupts + the runtime is disposed). Every QuickJSHandle is disposed (no heap leak). | 권한·안전 — glob matching (Cursor .mdc / Claude paths: 흡수) | ReDoS-hardened glob DP matcher (skill activation + Cursor rule paths) | **L4** `[B]` | Memoized dynamic-programming glob matcher for the constructs Claude Code's `paths:` and Cursor `.cursor/rules` `globs:` use: `**` (any chars incl. `/`, with an optional following `/` convenience), `*` (any run of non-`/`), `?` (one non-`/`), literals. A pattern without a `/` matches a path's basename at any depth (gitignore semantics). NOT regex by design: glob patterns come from attacker-influenceable frontmatter, and the obvious `**`→`.*` translation produces multiple unbounded `.*` quantifiers — a pattern like `**/x/**/x/**/x` compiles to `.*x/.*x/.*x` and catastrophically backtracks (O(nᵏ)) on a long NON-matching path, hanging the whole agent (DoS). JS lacks atomic groups / possessive quantifiers, so the matcher uses a memoized DP instead: every (token, position) pair is decided at most once → hard O(tokens · len²) ceiling with no exponential blowup. Hard caps on inputs: `MAX_GLOB_LEN = 4096`, `MAX_PATH_LEN = 8192`, combined work-budget `MAX_GLOB_WORK = 1 << 20` (tokens × len product). Over-cap inputs short-circuit to no-match (safe failure mode — a malicious oversized glob/path simply never matches). Used by skill activation (paths trigger) and Cursor rule path-matching. · src/skill/activation.ts, src/agent/glob-rules.ts · 4u/1i<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: absorbed:cursor · surface:cli · tier:1<br>**의존**: rules-matcher, glob-rules<br>**UI**: cli |

| 권한 머지 — 공급망/권한상승 차단 (ADR-0470) | Config-provenance gate — repo-controllable config may only NARROW, never widen | **L3** `[C]` | SECURITY 🔴. The layered config merge (src/permission/policy-layers/index.ts) ranks team-admin > per-repo > per-user > default and, under source-precedence, the most-authoritative source that SETS a field wins it. That is correct for ADMIN policy but a PRIVILEGE-ESCALATION / SUPPLY-CHAIN hole for REPO-controllable sources: a checked-in .quanta/.cursor policy OR an agent frontmatter block is `per-repo`, which out-ranks the USER's own per-user config on a grant-capable field — so cloning a hostile repo could silently grant itself approval.mode:"auto" (AFK auto-approve), widen the network egress / allow-list, or strip the OS sandbox. A repo may make the posture MORE restrictive (defense-in-depth is safe) but must NEVER widen it. This slice (src/permission/policy-layers/provenance-guard.ts, sibling-only deps inside @/permission) adds a PURE pre-merge filter guardProvenance that runs BEFORE mergeLayered. For each repo-controllable layer (closed set: per-repo / frontmatter) it DROPS any contribution to a grant-capable pillar (closed GRANT_CAPABLE_FIELDS = approval / network / sandbox) that WIDENS that axis relative to the trusted baseline (the widest value any per-user / team-admin / default sets; absent any trusted setter, the narrowest-possible value — a repo cannot bootstrap a grant from nothing). Repo contributions that match or NARROW are KEPT. "What is a widen" reuses the SSOT polarities NETWORK_RANK / APPROVAL_RANK (+ osSandbox presence) from profile-list-select.ts (no magic literal): approval.mode:"auto" is the AFK auto-approve (widest); promptUser:false is an INDEPENDENT loosening axis; network allowHosts set-append is a separate allow-list-widen the scalar rank can't see; sandbox widen = any protective bit removed. Emits one typed ProvenanceDropRecord {kind, field, source, detail} per dropped contribution — RETURNED, never emitted (composition root owns the sink, port inversion). NO-THROW, pure, deterministic. SECURITY DEFAULTS ON (NOT env-gated): a security control that ships OFF protects nobody, and an env var is itself attacker-settable. The ONLY disable path is an EXPLICIT typed acknowledgedRisk:true opt-out (mirrors ADR-0078 redaction opt-out). With the guard ON and no widens present, the output layer list is the SAME array reference as the input ⇒ the downstream merge is byte-identical to today. · src/permission/policy-layers/provenance-guard.ts, src/permission/profile-layer-merge.ts · ADR-470 · 1u · ⚙️acknowledgedRisk<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:cli · tier:core · security-touched · default-on<br>**의존**: agent<br>**Monitoring**: integrated · keys: quanta.permission.provenance_drop<br>**Configurable**: partial |

Codex network.mitm 흡수. ⚠️ CA 폭발반경 봉쇄(핵심): CA 는 EPHEMERAL(세션당 in-memory, OS trust store 미주입, 미영속). quanta 자신의 MITM'd outbound client 단일 소켓만 신뢰(NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS/ 시스템스토어/타프로세스 아님). UPSTREAM 검증은 약화 안 됨(rejectUnauthorized:true, default store + SNI; forged upstream cert ⇒ 502, 절대 blind-accept 아님). DEFAULT-OFF + OPERATOR-EXPLICIT-OPT-IN(타 knob 보다 강함): `QUANTA_TLS_MITM=1` AND verbatim ack `QUANTA_TLS_MITM_ACK=i-understand-mitm-mints-a-trust-anchor` 둘 다 필요 — stray `=1` 으로 trust anchor 못 켬. 부재 ⇒ CONNECT 가 raw 터널 + `connect-tunnel-unscanned` (byte-identical). 닫힌 포트/결정성: cert-gen 은 keyPairSource/serialSource/now/validity 주입(`MitmCertAuthority`). NO new dep — 순수 node:crypto hand-rolled X.509 v3 DER + crypto.sign(ECDSA-SHA256) (node:crypto 은 cert PARSE 만, GENERATE 불가라 직접 인코딩). NO-THROW fail-closed: handshake/mint/scan 에러 ⇒ deny(권장) 또는 opaque-tunnel(가시 마커). watchdog (handshakeTimeoutMs) 가 stuck handshake 를 hard deny 로 전환 — 절대 unscanned 통과 안 함. ✅ RUNTIME (RESOLVED jun-07): TLS 종단 메커니즘은 `MitmTlsChannel` seam 으로 capability-detect — Node 는 node:tls server-wrap, Bun 은 one-shot `Bun.listen({tls})` terminator + raw CONNECT 소켓 byte-pipe 브리지(Bun 은 server-wrap 한 raw 소켓에 ClientHello 미전달이라 node:tls 경로 stall → 브리지로 우회). 복호 plaintext 는 수동 HTTP 파서(`parseHttpRequestBuffer`)로 파싱(Bun 의 http.Server.emit("connection") 은 파싱 미구동, 스파이크로 확인). secret-egress 스캔/upstream-forward/fail-closed/ephemeral-CA /watchdog 는 두 transport 가 공유 — 보안모델 불변. | OS-sandbox usability — the user-gated escape hatch that unlocks a future default-ON sandbox | jun-6 sandbox-block → escalation-retry loop (denialReason:sandbox-blocked + HITL escape hatch) | **L3** `[A]` | OS sandbox 가 syscall 을 BLOCK 했을 때(=sandbox 가 제대로 작동) 와 일반 명령 실패를 구분하지 못하던 갭(`SandboxedSpawnResult` 에 denialReason 없음 → block 이 plain nonzero exit 과 byte-구분불가)을 닫는 RFC jun-6-sandbox-escalation 흡수 (Codex 0.135 `unix_escalation.rs` + `with_escalated_permissions` + `justification` + `ExecPolicyAmendmentExhausted`). 두 절반: (1) `denialReason:"sandbox-blocked"` discriminant + 순수 per-platform `classifySandboxDenial` (`src/runtime/os-sandbox/ denial-classify.ts`), (2) block → 기존 post-denial 3-step 머신(ADR-0046) 경유 → 유저-게이팅 unsandboxed re-run 의 escalation 루프(`src/agent/sandbox-escalation/`). 핵심-난이도(정직하게): detection FALSE-POSITIVE 리스크. `classifySandboxDenial` 은 ALWAYS `sandboxApplied===true` 일 때만 분류; HIGH-confidence = UNAMBIGUOUS 시그널만 (우리 seccomp 필터 하 SIGSYS / exit-126 denied-exec / EXACT line-anchored Seatbelt-deny stderr PREFIX — substring 절대 아님), LOW-confidence = bare EPERM (실제 non-sandbox permission 에러와 구분불가) ⇒ DECLINE-able 제안. 미인식 nonzero ⇒ plain failure (UNDER-detect over over-escalate). escalation NEVER auto-grants: recordRiskSeen-BEFORE- recordUserOverride ordering(타임스탬프, ADR-0046)이 조작된 override 차단; 승인 시 byte-same argv 를 NORMAL permission gate 통과 후 sandbox wrapper 없이 re-run(한 콜만, 세션 flip 아님). per-turn cap(`QUANTA_SANDBOX_ESCALATION_MAX`, ExecPolicyAmendmentExhausted analog)이 escalate→deny→escalate 스팸 차단. | Egress-proxy outbound header mutation — guarded operator transform riding the gated egress/MITM config | ticket-13 (§12.2) outbound header-rewrite — operator transform + forbidden-inject/forbidden-framing guards | **L2** `[C]` | egress-프록시가 buffered 요청을 OWN upstream 으로 재발신할 때, OUTBOUND 헤더맵에 적용하는 PURE / NO-THROW / NO-I/O 순서있는 변환(`applyHeaderRules`). 오퍼레이터가 `strip`/`set`/`append`/`rewrite` `HeaderRule` 리스트를 선언하면, plaintext-HTTP (`pipeBufferedHttp`, loopback-proxy.ts:468) 와 TLS-MITM (`mitmForwardUpstream`, :688) BOTH 경로에서 동일 코어로 적용. Claude-Code IDE cross-origin token-strip + Cursor value-redacted decision-log 흡수. ⚠️ REDACTION-WINS / DEFAULT-OFF (핵심): 변환은 secret-egress redaction PASS 뒤에 실행(`applyOutboundHeaderRules` 가 `dropHeaderValues` 필터 AFTER) — 규칙이 제거된 헤더를 절대 부활 못 시킴. `rules` 부재/빈배열 ⇒ SAME 객체 by-reference(byte-identical) + 빈 audit ⇒ 오늘 동작 byte-for-byte. 규칙은 이미-게이트된 `MitmConfig`/ `SecretEgressConfig` 에 올라타며 NO new env knob. 다층 방어계약(각각 redaction 과 독립): - NO-THROW NAME/VALUE 검증(DoS guard): EVERY op(strip 포함)이 node 자신의 `validateHeaderName`, value-op 는 `validateHeaderValue`(CR/LF/NUL 거부)로 검증. node 검증기 재사용 ⇒ 다운스트림 `http.request` 가 거부할 것을 EXACTLY 거부(over/under -reject 없음) + 절대 throw 안 함. 위반 ⇒ `malformed` 거부, 맵 무변경, 값 미기록. - FORBIDDEN-INJECT GUARD: `set`/`append` 가 credential 헤더(`authorization`/ `proxy-authorization`/`cookie`/`set-cookie`/`www-authenticate`/`proxy-authenticate`) 를 FORGE 못 함 — 조용히 무시(+ audit `fired:false` `forbidden-inject`). 이미 있는 credential 헤더의 `strip`/`rewrite` 는 정당한 하드닝이라 허용. - FORBIDDEN-FRAMING GUARD(request-smuggling + domain-fronting 방어): `set`/`append` 가 framing/routing 헤더(`transfer-encoding`/`content-length`/`host`/`connection`/ `proxy-connection`/`keep-alive`/`te`/`upgrade`)를 RE-INJECT 못 함 — 프록시 framing-fix AFTER 에 올라타면 CL.TE/TE.TE smuggling 또는 host forge → domain-fronting 가능하므로. `strip`/`rewrite` 는 inject op-policy 미러로 허용. - VALUE-FREE AUDIT: 각 entry 는 index/소문자 name/op/fired(+refusal reason) 만 — 값은 절대 미기록(secret 일 수 있음). 프록시 in-memory 로그로 RETURN(여기서 emit 안 함). ✅ WIRED-BUT-KNOBLESS / built-not-wired honesty: `applyHeaderRules` 는 두 callsite 에 LIVE 배선됨(CLI import-graph 도달). 그러나 어떤 env knob 도 rule LIST 를 POPULATE 하지 않음 — `headerRules` 는 게이트된 config 의 optional 필드일 뿐 오퍼레이터 surface 미존재. ⇒ prod 에선 default-OFF byte-identical arm 만 도달, rule-firing 은 e2e 가 config 직접 주입으로 검증. 그리고 `shouldStripOnRedirect`(cross-origin redirect token-strip 헬퍼)는 export+unit-tested 이나 CALLER 없음(프록시가 아직 redirect 미추종); `secret-egress.ts`/ `mitm.ts` 는 doc-comment 에서 future hook 으로만 참조 — deliberate_hold 로 기록. · src/runtime/network-proxy/header-rules.ts · ADR-521 · 1u/1i · ⚙️QUANTA_NETWORK_PROXY, QUANTA_TLS_MITM<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:core · security · security-touched · security-sensitive · absorbed:claude-code · absorbed:cursor<br>**의존**: secret-aware-egress, tls-mitm-egress, network-egress-proxy<br>**UI**: cli<br>**Monitoring**: integrated<br>**Configurable**: partial · env: QUANTA_NETWORK_PROXY, QUANTA_TLS_MITM |

Codex 0.135 의 per-action assessor (`GuardianAssessmentEvent` 11-field + `ReviewDecision` approved_exec/proposed_exec/network_policy_amendment/denied/abort/timed_out) 흡수. 타입드 `ActionAssessment` discriminated union (allow / allow_for_session / allow_with_edit / ask / deny / deny_and_steer / escalate)을 OPT-IN richer assessor 가 emit → 단 하나의 순수 boundary `collapseAssessment` 가 기존 8-state `ApprovalDecision` 으로 COLLAPSE → 기존 consumer(reviewer.ts dispatch / outcome.ts matrix / admissibility-gate routing)는 BYTE-IDENTICAL. assessor 는 OPTIONAL `ReviewerPort.guardianAssess?` 메서드 (최소 blast-radius); `reviewAction` 의 `dispatchFresh` 가 guardian tier + 메서드 present + 크놉 ON 일 때만 호출, 아니면 verbatim binary `guardianReview` fall-through. SAME guardian round-trip — extra LLM pass 없음(richer reply schema 만). SAFETY (load-bearing): collapse 는 TOTAL + CONSERVATIVE — allow/allow_for_session 만 allow outcome 로 collapse, 나머지 전부 + unknown/future/parse-failure kind 는 최소 deny(fail-closed), NEVER silent allow. allow_with_edit 는 절대 allow-original 로 degrade 안 함(corrected input 은 counter-proposal → steered deny; 원본 미실행). allow_for_session 은 machine assessor 가 세션-wide 권한 안 넓힘(one-shot guardian_approved). escalate 는 절대 auto-grant 안 함(forced ask). collapse 출력은 buildDecision 경유라 matrix 가 second-line(잘못된 pair ⇒ OutcomeInvariantError throw). DEFAULT-OFF byte-identical: 크놉 부재(또는 메서드 부재 — 모든 현 impl 이 omit) ⇒ guardianAssess 미호출, collapse 미도달, guardian path 가 현재 binary 와 동일. loose-truthy("true")는 미무장(strict `=== "1"`, security boundary). · src/permission/types.ts, src/permission/assessment-collapse.ts · ADR-497 · 2u · ⚙️QUANTA_GUARDIAN_ASSESSOR<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:cli · category:permission · security · security-touched · default-off · absorbed:codex<br>**의존**: reviewer-3tier, deny-and-steer-verb, review-kind-matrix, deny-reason-surfacing<br>**Monitoring**: integrated<br>**Configurable**: integrated · env: QUANTA_GUARDIAN_ASSESSOR |

Parser uses a DETERMINISTIC priority cascade on each `@<rest>` payload (first match wins): slash → file; uppercase-start → symbol (with optional one-level `.member`); lowercase-start + dot → file; lowercase-kebab → skill. `@@app` and `plugin://name` keep their own alternatives. ADR-0423 PRODUCTION @symbol (closes ADR-0422's anchor hold): a DETERMINISTIC LSP anchor synthesizer (`synthesizeLspAnchors`) walks cwd breadth-first (entries sorted per directory) and takes the lexicographically-first source file of each supported language — keyed by server binary from the single lsp-bridge SERVERS table — as that language's anchor. `createUnionLspSymbolLookup` then fans `workspaceSymbol(name)` across every synthesized anchor and merges hits (multi-language repo probes both servers). No scores, no thresholds. The host-composition `buildMentionSymbolDeps` pairs this with the REAL `@/runner` semantic backend (`selectIndexEmbedder` + `buildSemanticBackend`) and feeds both ports to `buildDefaultMentionResolver` at BOTH call sites (assemble.ts + mention-wire.ts), built LAZILY on first findSymbol so config assembly stays synchronous. So production @Symbol is now WIRED (LSP anchored → semantic fallback under `auto`) — graceful-null without an installed language server / a populated index, not unconditionally null by construction. Default-ON with GRACEFUL OMIT: an absent dep (no supported file ⇒ no anchor / no populated index / no skill registry / language server not installed) leaves that strategy answering null, never a regression. In a fresh checkout with no language server installed and an empty index, @symbol therefore still resolves null — the wire is present, the backing data is not. @skill resolves null at the assemble/CLI layer because no surface threads a `skills` registry. Sits ON TOP of the existing session-end consolidate pipeline (ADR-0068 `runPhase2`, ADR-0281 auto-trigger) — it does NOT reimplement consolidation. A small PERSISTED counter/clock (`DreamState`: sessions-since-last-dream + lastDreamAtMs) fires the EXISTING consolidator when EITHER threshold crosses: N session-ends OR H wall-clock hours since the last dream (OR semantics, mirroring Claude's `tengu_auto_dream_{fired,completed,skipped}` keyed on sessions_since / hours_since). The pass is guarded by a dedicated DREAM-LOCK (reuses the codebase `OAuthRefreshLockPort` in-memory / file-based impls via a local structural `DreamLockPort` seam so `@/memory` stays plane-clean) — a second concurrent process observes `would-wait` and skips. Consolidated cross- session knowledge is written to a SEPARATE `team/`-style target (`~/.quanta/memory/team/cross-session.md`), NEVER the user's live MEMORY.md (the `FileDreamWriteTarget` refuses to write any path named MEMORY.md). Default-OFF: with no `DreamPolicy` (i.e. `QUANTA_AUTO_DREAM` unset) the trigger never advances its counter, reads/writes no state, and fires no consolidate — byte-identical to the pre-H16 path. Determinism: the clock is INJECTED (no `Date.now()` in the slice); the hours-since math uses the injected clock only. No-throw: every side effect is wrapped; the slice never throws out of `onSessionEnd`/`dream` (an AbortError from the injected consolidate port propagates, mirroring the auto-trigger contract). The `/dream` slash command triggers a pass manually (bypasses the threshold but honors the lock + flag) and `/dream status` shows sessions/hours-since, last outcome, and the team target path. Zero deps: a Float32 little-endian buffer is the on-disk form (the SQLite embedding column is a BLOB), the in-memory form is a plain `number[]`. Shared by both memory adapters and the ranking layer so similarity semantics never diverge between InMemoryStore and SqliteStore. `dot(a, b)` returns 0 on length mismatch (treated as "incomparable"). `cosine(a, b)` returns 0 — never NaN — when either vector is empty, zero-magnitude, length-mismatched, or contains a non-finite component, so ranking stays total and deterministic. `normalize(a)` returns a zero/empty vector unchanged. `serializeVec` / `deserializeVec` round-trip the Float32 little-endian BLOB form. · src/memory/vector.ts, src/memory/dedup.ts · 2u<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:core<br>**의존**: memory-dedup-planner, embedder-port, memory-eviction-planner, tier, sqlite-persistent-store<br>**UI**: cli<br>**Configurable**: integrated |

SSOT policy module `src/agent/spawn-depth.ts` exposes `childDepthOf(parent)` (the ONLY authority for a child's depth = `parent.depth + 1`; the runner's `buildChildConfig` calls it against the REAL parent, ignoring caller-asserted `req.depth`, so forged `depth:0` hardcodes are inert), `SpawnLineageError` (malformed parent depth ⇒ fail-closed deny, no `depth:0` fallback), the two derived predicates `canExposeSpawnTools(parentDepth, cap)` / `canAdmitChildDepth(childDepth, cap)`, the rev.4 MIN-CAP resolver `effectiveCap(requested) = min(policy, requested ?? +∞)`, and `spawnToolsAvailable(config)`. The authoritative operator policy is runtime-config `maxDescendantDepth` = the max descendant depth a spawn may create; default 1 = root-only (rev.4 canonical, the user's leaf intent), overridable via `QUANTA_MAX_DESCENDANT_DEPTH` (`1` = root-only, `0` = no spawning). Per-config `subagent.maxDepth` (legacy `QUANTA_SUBAGENT_MAX_DEPTH`) can only TIGHTEN below policy, never raise it above the ceiling (min-cap — this resolves the two-knob split-brain). Not a heuristic: a numeric threshold on the existing `AgentConfig.depth` (0 = root), not a "usually leaf" estimate. · src/agent/spawn-depth.ts, src/agent/subagent-runner.ts · ADR-docs/plans/jul-13-subagent-nesting-control.md · 2u · ⚙️QUANTA_MAX_DESCENDANT_DEPTH<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:core · tier:1<br>**의존**: quantasubagent-maxdepth, tier1-subagent-block<br>**UI**: cli<br>**Modes**: interactive, headless<br>**Configurable**: integrated · env: QUANTA_MAX_DESCENDANT_DEPTH |

However, the parsed `AgentArgs.playbookTrigger` boolean was never threaded down from `apps/agent/index.ts` (or the REPL-surface argv path) to that dep slot — so typing `--playbook-trigger` did nothing today; only the env path worked. This ADR threads the boolean through 5 layers: 1. `apps/agent/index.ts` — `AssembleRequestPartial.playbookTrigger` + `toAssembleRequest` propagation (presence-only). 2. `apps/cli/internal.ts` — `playbookTriggerFlag()` argv reader (parallel to `newSessionFlag()` for SOLID/SRP). 3. `apps/cli/repl/session-runtime-config.ts` — surface as `SessionRuntimeConfig.playbookTriggerFlag`. 4. `apps/cli/repl/session-bootstrap.ts` — forward as `SessionBootstrapResult.playbookCliFlag: boolean \| undefined` (mapping `false → undefined` for `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`). 5. `apps/cli/repl/session-setup.ts` — forward to `SessionSetupResult.playbookCliFlag`. `apps/cli/repl.ts` adds 3 lines (comment + spread) to hand the boolean to `runSessionLoop({ playbookCliFlag })`. `session-loop.ts` already consumed `playbookCliFlag` per ADR-0299; no change there. | 서브에이전트 — background task lifecycle + capability gating | TaskRegistry — background subagent registry + capability tokens + LRU | **L4** `[B]` | In-memory registry of background subagent tasks (v2's `taskRegistry` shape). Agent tool registers a task here when launched in background mode and resolves it when the forked runner settles; `task_output` / `task_stop` observe and cancel by id. Three seams: (1) `register()` returns the per-task `AbortController` — callers MUST plumb its `.signal` into the runner's request via `SubagentRequest.signal` so `stop(id)` actually unwinds the child (historical bug class fixed). (2) S17 capability token — `register()` returns an unforgeable `TaskOwnerToken` (128-bit `crypto.randomUUID()`) alongside the task id; the spawner stashes the token and surrenders it back to `stop(id, ownerToken)`. Without matching token, `stop()` REFUSES — a sibling subagent that learns another's `id` cannot DoS-cancel it. (3) LRU eviction — `maxRetained` cap (default 256) applies to SETTLED records only; running tasks never evict, never count toward the cap. Oldest-by-`endedAt` settled records evict first. Lives for the process — not persisted. (1) `task_kind: "read"\|"edit"\| "review"` — coarse role used to derive a default tool allowlist when `tools` is omitted (read = pure inspection; edit = inspection + writers + bash; review = strictest read-only critique). Explicit `tools` ALWAYS wins. (2) `result_shape` — one-line format spec for the child's final answer (e.g. `"JSON: {ok, files[], summary}"`), injected into the child's seed prompt. (3) `owned_surfaces` / (4) `forbidden_surfaces` — files/ paths the child is permitted to read/modify vs MUST NOT touch (paired). (5) `continue_from: <prior_task_id>` — settled background task's `finalText` prepended to the new child's seed as a "Previous attempt" block; unknown/evicted id returns a recoverable error. Behavior matrix (FSM 4 분기): - no resume / no new-session → legacy default (empty history, initialId) - `--resume <path-like>` → V1 path-mode (loadSession + slog) - `--resume <id-like>` → V2 id-mode (loadSessionById, idMeta set) - `--new-session [--title t]` → V2 id-mode (mint fresh id + stub save) Path-like heuristic (`isPathLikeToken`): `/` 또는 `\` 포함 OR `.json` 끝나면 path-mode, 아니면 opaque id 로 id-mode (`loadSessionById` 호출). 결과 envelope (`ResumeResolution`): history / sessionId / idMeta / inIdMode 플래그 + `missingIdError` / `conflictError` sentinel. HIGH-5 guardrails: - `--new-session --resume <id>` 동시 지정 → `conflictError` 로 거부 (이전엔 silent ignore). 둘 다 명시되면 어느 id 가 winning 인지 모호하기 때문. - `--resume <id>` 가 resolve 실패 → `missingIdError` sentinel → caller exit 1. | 스킬 — 번들 시스템 스킬 (debugging + code archaeology, Cursor CTK §⑧ 패턴 흡수) | debug/blame 시스템 스킬 트리오 — debug-trace / explain-stack-trace / blame-section (ADR-0176) | **L4** `[A]` | 세 개의 워크플로 형태 시스템 스킬을 한 번에 흡수 — 모두 prompt-only, 새 도구 추가 없음, 사용자가 query를 좁히며 반복 iterate 하는 narrative 워크플로. 1. **debug-trace** — "이거 크래시 났어 / 이 에러 조사해 줘". `parse_test_failure` 도구로 raw error text 먼저 결정적 parse → 각 frame을 `Read`로 열어보고 → caller frame vs root-cause frame 구분 → `file:line + 한 줄 원인 + 한 줄 fix` 형태 ranked hypothesis 생성. fix는 적용하지 않음 (그건 `debug-error` 의 일). allowedTools: `[Bash, Read, Grep, parse_test_failure, file_tree_summary]`. 2. **explain-stack-trace** — "이 stack trace 설명해 줘 / 이 에러가 뭐 말하는 거야". 순수 read-only narrative 스킬. `parse_test_failure` parse → exception class 의미 (언어 ecosystem별) 식별 → bottom-up walk (크래시 난 곳 → outer caller → user-code 경계) → 한 paragraph plain-English summary. **fix 제안 절대 안 함** — `debug-trace`로 handoff 문장으로 마무리. allowedTools: `[Read, Grep, parse_test_failure]`. 3. **blame-section** — "이 섹션 누가 썼어? / 이 라인들 git blame". 기존 `git_blame_heatmap` 도구의 `start_line`/`end_line` 범위 형태 (ADR-0096)을 wrap. 결과를 author + commit 별로 grouping → top-3 author + 라인 수 → ≥2 specific commit SHA 인용 (most-touched + most-recent) → ORIGINAL author (pickaxe `git log -S` / `-L:funcname:file`) vs RECENT editor (default git blame answer) 명확 구분. allowedTools: `[Bash, Read, git_blame, git_blame_heatmap]`. A cheap injected `LLMPort` (pinned to `QUANTA_SESSION_TITLE_MODEL`, mirroring the `QUANTA_COMPACT_MODEL` precedent) summarizes the first user prompt into a ≤6-word title, sanitized (NON- whitespace C0/C1 control chars stripped — NUL/BEL/BS/ESC-ANSI/DEL/C1, a terminal-escape / NUL-injection guard against a hostile model output writing control bytes into the session metadata record; whitespace control chars kept as word boundaries; whitespace collapsed, wrapping quotes dropped, clamped to maxWords + MAX_TITLE_CHARS), and written to `SessionMeta.title` via the injected `rename` adapter over `renameSession`. Three hard invariants, locked by the hellgate battery: (1) Default-OFF — the port is built ONLY when `QUANTA_SESSION_AUTO_TITLE` is set AND a cheap `QUANTA_SESSION_TITLE_MODEL` port exists; absent ⇒ the loop branch is dead ⇒ byte-identical, no extra LLM call, no title write. (2) Never blocks — `maybeTitle` returns `void` synchronously; the real work runs on a DETACHED promise the turn never awaits. A slow / hung call is abandoned via the injected-clock `timeoutMs`; every failure (LLM throw, timeout, rename throw, read throw) is caught and swallowed. (3) Don't-clobber — before writing, the titler RE-READS the current title via the injected `currentTitle` reader; if a human renamed the session (the title is no longer a placeholder per the injected `isPlaceholder` predicate) the write is SKIPPED — manual rename always wins. Closed-port: the leaf imports ONLY `@/llm` types (`LLMPort`, `StreamEvent`, `assembleFromEvents`) and consumes everything else (rename writer, title reader, placeholder predicate, clock, debug sink) as injected ports — it does NOT import `@/session` store internals or `@/agent` loop internals. | LLM resilience — proactive rate-limit (complements B3 retry-after) | Account rate-limit snapshot — proactive empty-bucket backoff from *-ratelimit-* headers | **L3** `[B]` | Today quanta is purely REACTIVE to rate limits: B3 (`parseRetryAfterMs`, `src/shared/errors.ts`) parses the `retry-after` family ONLY at the error boundary and waits the server-instructed delay AFTER a 429 has already burned a request. It never reads the `*-ratelimit-*-remaining` / `*-reset` headers that providers return on EVERY response (success or failure), which advertise the live quota meter. This slice adds the PROACTIVE half: a pure snapshot parser that reads the remaining/reset headers, a per-route last-write-wins store, a SERVER-ANCHORED empty-bucket policy, and a no-leak notify event. Pure parser `src/llm/ratelimit-snapshot/parse.ts` (`parseRateLimitSnapshot`) reads a CLOSED allowlist of BOTH vendor spellings — `anthropic-ratelimit-{requests,tokens}-{remaining,reset}` and the OpenAI mirror `x-ratelimit-{remaining,reset}-{requests,tokens}`. The `*-reset` parse reuses B3's magnitude-band + HTTP-date discipline (epoch-ms ≥1e12 / epoch-s ≥1e9 / relative-s, past ⇒ undefined) via a parity-locked duplicate (`parseRateLimitResetMs`) — the original `parseRateLimitResetHeader` is private to the error boundary, which is out of scope to edit, so a differential-parity test pins the duplicate to it. Garbage ⇒ field absent (NEVER coerced to 0/NaN); a hostile getter ⇒ no snapshot (no-throw); no recognized header ⇒ `undefined` ⇒ the store keeps its last value ⇒ byte-identical to today's reactive path. The policy `proactiveDelayMs` (`policy.ts`) backs off ONLY when a provider window reports `remaining <= 0`, then waits the provider's OWN reset of the empty window(s) (tightest binding window wins), clamped to the SAME 60s ceiling B3 uses. This is NOT a quanta-invented percentage/margin threshold — it is the same measured signal B3 honors after a 429, consulted BEFORE the request (no invented heuristic; the soft-margin case is deferred to an opt-in Phase 2). It is a DIAGNOSTIC, not a behavior change: it never runs on the hot path (a `/doctor`-style or empty-list trigger invokes it), so there is no default-OFF byte-identity concern and no gate. NEVER throws — every fs error (including an invalid on-disk filename that makes the path-builder throw SessionIdError) is captured into the report as `corrupt`. In STRICT mode (eval) the first failure rethrows so the caller can mark the instance verdict `degraded`. No IO, deterministic. Fills the gap that every modern agent leaves — Cursor's IDE panel, Claude Code session totals, Codex per-model OTel breakdown all emit unstructured logs but none expose a typed registry the operator can query in-process (`tool_calls_total`, `turn_duration_ms`, `verify_gate_pass_total`, …) AND export to an out-of-process collector with the SAME data model. Six explicit contracts: 1. PURE STORE — in-memory only, 0 I/O; the optional `MetricSink` is the only transport. With no sink, the registry is a snapshot-only primitive (Default-OFF posture per ADR-0144). 2. NAME COMMITS TO KIND on first use — `increment("foo")` after `gauge("foo", 5)` throws `MetricsError("name-mismatch-kind")`. Labels do NOT affect commitment — `foo{a=1}` and `foo{a=2}` share the kind. 3. SINK NO-THROW — `sink.send` wrapped in try/catch; a throwing sink logs nothing (observability plane must not crash the agent); the registry still records the sample. 4. NEGATIVE / NON-FINITE INPUT coerces to 0. Same posture as `BudgetMeter.tick`. 5. PERCENTILES via nearest-rank on a sorted ascending copy; empty sample → zeros. `histogramBuckets` reserved for a future bucketed-exposition adapter. 6. LABELS sorted lexicographically when forming the series key so `{a:1,b:2}` and `{b:2,a:1}` share one time-series. Built-in sinks ship for `console` (stderr line-by-line) and `jsonl` (append `JSON.stringify(sample) + "\n"`; directory auto-created). This slice adds a PURE classifier (no I/O, no-throw) over `{command, stdout, exitCode}` that derives the same structured shape an explicit directive would carry: `{commit:{sha,kind}, push:{localRef,remoteRef}, branch:{action:merged\|rebased\|amended}, pr:{number,url}}`. Patterns mirror Claude Code's `g27` classifier vocabulary (cited per-pattern in `classifier.ts`): `Fast-forward` / `Merge made by` → merged; `Successfully rebased` → rebased; `--amend` (command-shape) → amended; `git cherry-pick` + landed `[branch sha]` → cherry-pick; a push ref-update line (`<old>..<new> <local> -> <remote>` / `* [new branch] ...`) → push; `Pull request `[branch sha]` / `[main (root-commit) sha]` / `[detached HEAD sha]` / `HEAD is now at sha`. | LSP — stdio Content-Length framing | LSP JSON-RPC 2.0 codec — Content-Length framed (MessageReader / encodeMessage) | **L4** `[B]` | Wire-level codec behind `lsp-bridge` and `lspport`. LSP framing is NOT MCP's newline-delimited shape: every message is a JSON body preceded by an HTTP- style `Content-Length: N\r\n\r\n` header. The single hardest correctness risk in an LSP client is the stream framing — a server may flush several messages in one chunk OR split a single message (even its header) across many chunks. `MessageReader` owns a byte buffer and only emits a message once the full `Content-Length` body bytes have arrived, so partial reads AND coalesced messages are both handled. Closed `JsonRpcMessage` discriminated union — response (by `id`) vs notification/request (by `method`). `encodeMessage` writes a `Content-Length` header in bytes (not chars) so multi-byte UTF-8 payloads frame correctly. Companion of `mcp-client-jsonrpc` (newline-delimited variant) and `jsonrpc-envelope` (the standalone JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope SoT). · src/lsp/adapters/jsonrpc.ts, src/lsp/adapters/base.ts · ADR-15 · 1u<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:ipc · absorbed:codex<br>**의존**: mcp-client-jsonrpc, jsonrpc-envelope, lsp-bridge<br>**UI**: api<br>**Configurable**: partial |

HOURLY / MINUTELY / SECONDLY / YEARLY and the BYSETPOS / BYWEEKNO / BYYEARDAY superset are intentionally out of scope — Codex's `automation-schedule` uses only DAILY / WEEKLY / MONTHLY in production. Every rejection maps to one of the closed `RRuleParseErrorCode` arms (`malformed` / `unsupported-freq` / `count-and-until` / `invalid-byday`) so callers branch deterministically without prose parsing. Strict ordinal range: `+1..+5` and `-5..-1`. Zero ordinal (`+0MO`), out-of-range (`+6MO`), and unknown weekday tokens are rejected (returning `undefined` — caller skips). `nthWeekdayOfMonth(year, month, day, nth)` returns `undefined` when the requested occurrence does NOT exist in that month (e.g. 5th Monday of Feb 2026 — only 4 Mondays); callers (the evaluator) skip to the next month. All computation is UTC — the caller surface owns local-time/DST display conversion. Honored response channels: `deny` ⇒ short-circuit into aborted (the surface observes AgentOutcome.reason === "aborted" + a hook-origin stop category); `updatedPrompt: string` ⇒ rewrites the trailing user message's first text block in place (the LLM sees only the rewritten text). Handlers may return `{abortReason}` to skip THIS compaction (the breaker observes the no-op). Use cases: snapshot before lossy compaction, audit log, defer to off-hours. (3) subagent_stop — emitted by subagent-runner.ts AFTER a forked child returns (success/fail/cancel). Fire-and-forget for status reporting; an abort here is meaningless (the child already finished). promptHook on this event is queued for the parent's NEXT turn. Default-OFF, byte-identical: gated by `QUANTA_MCP_OAUTH_KEYRING=1` AND `QUANTA_MCP_OAUTH=1` AND the OS keyring `available()`. | ChatGPT-OAuth logout lifecycle (ADR-0094) | Revoke OAuth tokens on logout (RFC 7009, best-effort, NO-THROW, default-OFF) | **L2** `[B]` | Close a credential-lifetime hole at `/logout` (jun-6 RFC). Today logout deletes ONLY the local token file (`deleteToken` → `unlink`); the server-side refresh token stays valid until it naturally expires, so anyone who captured it (a leaked backup, a stale process, a compromised disk before the delete) keeps access AFTER the user believed they signed out. When the knob `QUANTA_OAUTH_REVOKE_ON_LOGOUT` is ON, logout first best-effort POSTs the refresh token to the IdP's revocation endpoint (`${issuer}/oauth/revoke`, RFC 7009: `token=<rt>&token_type_hint=refresh_token &client_id=<id>` in the BODY) so the server-side credential is invalidated, not merely forgotten locally. A successful revoke (RFC §2.1) also invalidates the associated access tokens; RFC §2.2 makes it idempotent (an already-revoked / unknown token returns 200) so a double-logout is harmless. `revokeRefreshToken` (`src/auth/chatgpt-oauth/revoke.ts`) is a closed-port leaf: the only side effect is an injected `fetchPort` (same seam as the OAuth refresh/token POST) — no global fetch, no `process.env`, no `Date.now`. It NEVER throws: every failure (empty token, network error, non-2xx incl. a 404 from an IdP without a revoke endpoint) resolves to a typed `RevokeOutcome` so the caller logs a reason code (NEVER the token) and proceeds. Invariants (RFC §4.5): the LOCAL delete is unconditional and first-class — revoke runs BEFORE `deleteToken` but its outcome NEVER gates the delete, so a hung/failing revoke can never leave a stale local token (logout can only match-or-beat today). The token rides the POST body only — never a URL/argv/log (bearer-redaction discipline). Codex-managed tokens are NEVER revoked: the `source === "codex"` branch returns BEFORE revoke (we don't own that credential). Default-OFF is byte-identical: knob unset ⇒ `/logout` constructs no revoke endpoint, issues no network call, and renders the exact pre-RFC box (no `revoke` kvLine). The knob threads as a `LogoutDeps.revokeOnLogout` param from the composition root (`runtimeConfig().oauthRevokeOnLogout`); the revoke module itself reads no env. N6 adds a gated `@/tool/pty` slice exposing 6 model-facing tools over ONE `PtySessionPort` with two ZERO-DEP backends (Cursor's "tmux → pty_id" cue): pty_list (read-only) — enumerate attachable handles (handle/kind/cwd/owned) pty_attach (exec) — idempotent attach, returns the resumable output cursor pty_write (exec) — live stdin (64 KiB cap; appendNewline submits a line) pty_read (read-only) — resumable stdout since a cursor (the Cursor last_event_id invariant) pty_resize (exec) — (cols, rows), bounded 1..1000 pty_kill (exec) — terminate owned / allow-listed handles The dep crux is RESOLVED with no dependency: tmux is an external binary already on the host (`createTmuxAdapter` — `send-keys`/`capture-pane`/`resize-window`, the MVP-A attach-to-existing backend), and Bun 1.3.14 ships a native PTY (`Bun.Terminal`) for the Phase-1b real-tty backend. node-pty is avoided. It mirrors the port contract EXACTLY (same 7 NO-THROW methods + the same caps) and adds a `spawn`/`closeAll` entry point. Security inversion: owned ⇒ NO foreign-jail (no "attach to someone else's terminal" risk); the ONLY trust boundary is the cwd-jail at spawn. Output is drained from Bun's `data` callback into a bounded (256 KiB) ring with a monotone seq + an explicit gap marker on overflow (byte-exact, no silent drop). The reply is scanned for a complete `*** Begin Patch` … `*** End Patch` block. - complete block found ⇒ `{ ok:true, newPatch, modelUsed }` - prose / no block / truncated (Begin but no End) ⇒ `{ ok:false, newPatch:null, rationale }` (never a half patch) The fast executor model is chosen via the injected resolver `roleResolver.resolve("executor", defaultModel)` (Roo-style per-role selection); on a role miss the resolver returns `defaultModel`. | Edit-apply ladder recovery (ADR-0500, jun-7-misc 06) | Model-based fast-apply MERGE rung (apply-model elision merge) | **L3** `[A]` | A NEW closed `FastApplyPort` (merge direction) sibling to the existing V4A re-emit `FastApplyFallbackPort`. Where re-emit re-authors a patch that must itself re-anchor, the MERGE port asks a DEDICATED apply model to fold a terse `// ... existing code ...` edit sketch directly into the full original file and return the MERGED full file (Cursor 3.5.33 REWRITE-flavor apply IO shape) — no second round of diff anchoring. Inserted as an OPTIONAL rung in the `edit` ladder: `exact → fuzzy → [model MERGE] → typed mismatch`. Reached ONLY when the deterministic exact/fuzzy ladder MISSES AND `ctx.fastApplyMerge` is wired. The merge is a PROPOSAL, never a blind write. Two-layer verification: (1) runner STRUCTURAL check (`verifyMergeStructural`): non-empty, changed-vs-original, no leftover elision marker, complete fenced block. (2) edit-scoped bounded check (`verifyEditScopedMerge`): must ADD new_string (its occurrence count strictly INCREASES vs the original — R3 audit; mere `includes(new_string)` is UNSOUND when new_string already exists unrelated to the edit, letting a drop-others merge pass while keeping the pre-existing occurrence), must not still contain old_string (unless new_string legitimately re-introduces it), must differ from the original, AND (R1 audit) REJECT an empty new_string (the `includes("")` landed-signal is vacuous, so arbitrary content would otherwise pass). (R1 audit) The rung is also SKIPPED entirely when the caller supplied `line_ranges`: a whole-file merge cannot honor a bounded scope, so a model merge could mutate lines OUTSIDE the declared span — fail-closed to the typed mismatch instead. (R2 audit) The rung is likewise SKIPPED under `replace_all`: that is a deterministic "change EVERY occurrence" contract, but a whole-file merge + single-occurrence verification cannot prove all N sites changed (a partial merge would pass `includes(new_string)`) — fail-closed instead. (R4 audit) DEFENSE-IN-DEPTH against the duck-typed port: `verifyEditScopedMerge` ALSO rejects a merged file that still literally contains the `// ... existing code ...` elision marker BEYOND what the original + new_string legitimately account for. The runner's structural check rejects this, but the consumer must NOT trust an arbitrary `ctx.fastApplyMerge` implementation to have run it: a buggy/compromised port that returns a merge where the apply model COPIED the sketch verbatim (dropping the real lines the marker stood for) would otherwise pass the edit-scoped check (new_string lands, old absent) and write the corrupted file. The count-attributed bound avoids over-rejecting a legitimate edit whose new_string genuinely embeds the marker (EM-17 RED / EM-18 GREEN). (R2 KNOWN GAP, ticket §9.3) SEMANTIC content-drop is NOT deterministically caught: a merge that lands new_string (even in a comment) while dropping unrelated real code passes the presence/absence gate. Bounding it needs a structural diff with a delta threshold (a magic number forbidden by [[no-heuristics-only-validated]]). The backstop is the reviewer/diff gate (§4.c): the full before/after IS fed to the `ToolDiffSink`, so the drop is SURFACED to the human/reviewer, never a silent side-channel write (EM-14 pins this; flip it to fail-closed if a validated bound lands). An accepted merge then flows through the SAME gated commit + `ToolDiffSink` path as ANY edit — there is NO code path that writes a merged file without verification + the normal gate. NO-THROW / fail-closed: a role-resolve throw, dispatch throw, non-ok reply, empty/truncated reply, or ANY verification miss ⇒ `{ ok:false, merged:null }` ⇒ the ladder falls through to the byte-identical typed mismatch. The apply model is resolved under a NEW `"apply"` role from the operator-set `QUANTA_FAST_APPLY_MODEL` — NEVER the main agent model (that defeats the cost win). Reuses quanta's OWN `@/llm` provider seam — no hosted Morph/Relace dep, no new egress endpoint. Slice fence: producer types + `@/shared` only (collaborators duck-typed); `@/tool` references the merge port via a duck-typed `FastApplyMergeSeam` mirror so it never imports `@/agent`. · src/agent/fast-apply-fallback/types.ts, src/agent/fast-apply-fallback/merge-runner.ts · ADR-docs/decisions/0500-model-based-fast-apply-merge.md · 2u · ⚙️QUANTA_FAST_APPLY_MERGE, QUANTA_FAST_APPLY_MODEL<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:core · default-off · ports-only · security-gated<br>**의존**: fast-apply-fallback<br>**UI**: cli<br>**Modes**: interactive, headless<br>**Configurable**: integrated · env: QUANTA_FAST_APPLY_MERGE, QUANTA_FAST_APPLY_MODEL |

When a V4A patch FAILS to apply, the tool optionally calls the fallback (executor-model re-emits the patch) and retries the V4A applier ONCE. Seam: a new OPTIONAL `ToolContext.fastApplyFallback` (duck-typed `FastApplyFallbackSeam`, structural mirror of `FastApplyFallbackPort` so the `@/tool` slice never imports `@/agent`). The dispatch seam (composition root in `@/agent`, a SEPARATE follow-up) wires the concrete port from `AgentConfig.fastApplyFallback`. Flow when the port is present and `parseAndApply` throws: - `classifyFastApplyError(err)` maps the V4A error class to the closed `errorKind` (`anchor_not_found` \| `apply_error` \| `parse_error`), or `null` for non-recoverable errors. `FsJailViolationError` + any non-patch error ⇒ `null` (a re-emit cannot escape a SECURITY boundary, so no fallback is spent — the error surfaces immediately). - an already-aborted `ctx.signal` short-circuits (no I/O, no dispatch). - `failingTargetPath(err)` pulls `.path` off anchor/apply errors so the wire reads the failing file's current bytes (re-anchoring snapshot) via the already-constructed `PatchFileSystemPort`. Parse errors have no bound target ⇒ no snapshot. - `fallback.attempt({ failure, sourceFile?, sourceContent? }, signal)` is guarded by a try/catch — a port that breaks its no-throw contract MUST NOT mask the real failure. - `ok:true` + non-null `newPatch` ⇒ re-run `parseAndApply` ONCE. A retry that ALSO fails surfaces the ORIGINAL error (never the retry's). `ok:false` / aborted / thrown / no-patch ⇒ original error. On a rescued apply the terminal `result.output` appends ` (recovered via fast-apply fallback, model <modelUsed>)` so the trajectory records the recovery. | CLI / agent entry — env file loader | .env loader — first-wins, no-override, `export ` strip, no-deps | **L5** `[B]` | Tiny no-dependency `.env` loader (`loadEnvFiles(files)`). Both CLI surfaces (`src/apps/cli/index.ts` and `src/apps/agent/index.ts`) invoke it with the same precedence chain — `[".env.dev", ".env.local", ".env"]` — at process start, BEFORE any module reads `process.env`. Three deliberate semantics: (1) NO-OVERRIDE — a key already set in the real environment wins; the file is only consulted for unset keys, so a CI / shell-exported override is never silently masked by a stale repo `.env`. (2) FIRST-WINS across files — earlier files in the array shadow later ones (`.env.dev` > `.env.local` > `.env`), matching the real precedence: the more-specific override wins. (3) `export ` prefix is stripped so a file that doubles as a shell `source` works unchanged (`export FOO=bar` parses key `FOO`, not `export FOO`). Quotes (single/double) on values are stripped; blank lines and `#` comments are skipped. Zero runtime dependency on the `dotenv` npm package — the parser is ~30 LOC and lives in-tree. · src/apps/cli/dotenv.ts, src/apps/cli/index.ts · 1u<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:cli<br>**의존**: repl-code-smell-cleanup, repl-interactive-surface, slashctx-6-ports-wire-completion, multimodal-image-input, shell-output-delta-streaming<br>**UI**: cli<br>**Modes**: interactive<br>**Configurable**: integrated · env: QUANTA_PROVIDER, QUANTA_SANDBOX |

The CLI accepts `--store-dir DIR` so isolated test fixtures, replayed artifacts, and ad-hoc analysis do not have to share the repo-default `evals/runs`. The numbers are NOT invented: the base 8-colour set is the **Okabe-Ito** "Color Universal Design" palette (Okabe & Ito 2008; Wong, Nature Methods 8, 441, 2011) — the field-standard categorical set engineered to stay separable under the three common dichromacies. Per-condition variants re-use that same anchor set, re-ordered/pruned to the hues that survive best: deuteranopia / protanopia lean on the blue↔orange↔yellow axis; tritanopia on the red↔green↔purple axis; achromatopsia uses luminance-distinct greys only. `getColorPalette(theme)` is a pure total function — an exact palette id returns that palette; a generic light/dark/auto/claude or any unknown/empty value returns the `default` (full Okabe-Ito) palette. It uses `Object.hasOwn` (NOT the `in` operator) so prototype keys (`constructor`/`__proto__`/`toString`) cannot index `Object.prototype` members — guaranteeing "always a usable palette, never throws". Isolated in its own `*-cmd.ts` so its `model-picker` import is allowed under the ADR-0306 fence (registry imports it as an opaque `SlashCommand`). `model-adapter.ts` (ctx-adapter): projects the surface's model facts onto the `SlashContext.model` slot. `current()` = host getter (wins) → per-mode SYNC SHADOW (this adapter's own `set()` updates it, so an in-surface set is reflected IMMEDIATELY — the sticky store is async, a sync getter could only return a Promise) → boot model. `candidates()` = boot + retry ids, deduped, enriched from the provider-metadata SSOT (window/output/recommended/hint, `deriveHint` derived purely from `reasoning`+window — no drifting hardcoded table). `set(id)` persists via the SAME `StickyModelStore` the loop's CONSUME side reads (ADR-0462), keyed to the CURRENT mode (mode-implicit), returning a typed outcome (`ok`\|`invalid-mode`\|`write-error`) — never throws. So `/model` and `/sticky-model` agree on one store. | 벤치 — verify-and-select repro 오라클 보정 (측정도구) | repro-oracle gold calibration — EVAL-ONLY false-negative diagnostic | **L3** `[B]` | EVAL-ONLY DIAGNOSTIC, NOT a production solving capability. It needs the dataset gold patch as ground truth, so live tasks have no gold and this is unavailable off-bench. It calibrates the noisy patched-resolved oracle by running the same probe on the gold-patched tree. If the probe says "not resolved" on the known-correct fix, the oracle is a confirmed false-negative for that instance and the resolved gate fails open, meaning it never rejects a candidate on that signal. Two jobs: 1. Measure the oracle's per-instance false-negative rate, which is the jun-20 root-cause readout for the "right place, fix unrecognized by oracle" miss family. 2. De-noise bench candidate selection so a broken oracle cannot discard a correct candidate before official grading. Asymmetric limitation: fail-open removes a false-red, but it does not add a true-green. Selection then degrades to weak minimality plus ownerCoverage, so the correct candidate may still lose to a wrong sibling. It does not cheat grading: the final verdict is still the independent official harness; fail-open only changes which candidate is submitted. · src/runner/batch/eval/repro-oracle-calibration.ts, src/runner/batch/eval/driver.ts · ADR-14 · 1u/1i<br>**소유자**: @songmin<br>**Labels**: surface:bench · eval-only · diagnostic · not-production-capability<br>**의존**: repro-test-slice, verify-select<br>**Modes**: batch<br>**Configurable**: integrated · env: QUANTA_BENCH_VERIFY_SELECT |

- **Per-tool / per-skill checkpoint granularity (ADR-0209)** (L3) — DoF-15 (jul-16 default-OFF SOTA++ board): the per-tool RECORD producer is
LIVE under `QUANTA_PER_TOOL_RECORD=on` (surface-compose wires the granular
policy into the dispatch-wrap producer + the /rewind-tool consumer), but
the DEFAULT stays OFF. Decision (c): deliberately HOLD the producer with
BOUNDED retention + a typed PRODUCER-ONLY inspection accessor — NOT a
second snapshot authority. The single ADR-0209 `GranularRegistry` (tag→SHA)
is the sole authority; the deleted ADR-0300 raw-content store was NOT
resurrected.
Retention policy (bounds proven in per-tool-record-lifecycle-hellgate):
  - anchors LRU-capped at `maxRegistryEntries` (default 200, min 1);
  - the per-(workspace,turnId) call-index counter LRU-capped at
    DEFAULT_MAX_CALL_INDEX_KEYS (1000) — the pre-DoF-15 unbounded vector;
  - `registry.clear()` resets BOTH anchors AND the counter, and is called
    on session teardown via `disposePerToolRecord` (repl.ts finally block);
  - OFF path wraps ZERO tools: `wireCheckpointedEffectChannel` returns the
    SAME channel reference (no wrap, no registry allocation).
Inspection is PRODUCER-ONLY: `registry.stats()` is a pure read-only
projection ({entryCount, entryCap, counterCount, counterCap}); nothing in
the loop consumes it to drive behaviour. → To flip the default ON, wire the `/rewind-tool` RESTORE consumer as the
canonical product consumer (the raw checkpoint adapter → /rewind-tool) at
the CLI composition root — a change to `src/apps/cli/repl/surface-compose.ts`
(a forbidden composition root for the DoF-15 leaf; returned as a text
follow-up). No new snapshot store is permitted — the promotion re-uses the
existing ADR-0209 registry + ADR-0210 three-way-restore port.

operator-approved command through `runShellWithSnapshot(...)` instead of the
direct spawner. Security-risk row ⇒ opt-in explicit, first-class, never a
silent default flip.

## Codex 특정 의도적 미흡수 (ADR-0015~0023 근거)

- **Heartbeat/cron 자동화** (`codex_app.automation_update`) — CLI/bench는 single-session, 적용 부재
- **Plugin bundle** (skills + MCP + app capability 묶음 패키징) — skill 단독으로 커버, plugin 형식은 ROI 낮음
- **Cassette validator 엄격 per-entry 검증** — Codex 자체가 placeholder로 표기, 본 환경도 동일 보류
- **숨겨진 global memory DB** — Codex가 NON-CLAIM으로 표기. 본 환경은 명시적 `QUANTA_MEMORY_PATH` 영속만 사용
- **Git directive 5종** (`::git-stage`/`::git-commit` 등 UI 레일 명령) — CLI에 UI 레일 없음, `bash`/`git_*` 도구로 충분

## 의도적 미흡수 (제품/운영/실험 인프라 — ADR-0011 근거)

백그라운드 데몬 · Statsig 원격게이트/kill-switch · Datadog+cohort 텔레메트리 · full speculative-prompt-execution
